title: RepoAssure M1 Open Evidence Kernel Candidate Boundary Contract Specification Authorization Maintainer Decision Recording v0.1
objective: After separate execution authorization and only with one explicit exact maintainer choice, record exactly one K1 contract-specification authorization decision without inferring an answer, drafting a specification, creating or promoting a schema, accepting an authoritative contract, implementing an adapter or runtime, or advancing M1.
acceptance: Begin only after the authorization-intake Goal is completed, this exact decision-recording Goal receives separate execution authorization, and one explicit exact maintainer choice is supplied in the current task.

Record exactly one of approve_for_separately_gated_contract_specification_drafting, request_contract_design_revision, defer_contract_specification_drafting, reject_contract_specification_path; reject ambiguous, missing, multiple, or out-of-vocabulary input.

The recorder must not infer a choice from this Goal execution authorization, the earlier design approval, option order, recommendations, defaults, or prior task history; without exact choice evidence, remain pending.

If approve_for_separately_gated_contract_specification_drafting is explicitly chosen, derive at most one contract-specification drafting Goal with execution_authorization null; the choice itself does not authorize drafting, schema creation, contract acceptance, implementation, or M1 advancement.

Keep original contracts and artifact bytes authoritative, K1 non-authoritative, M1 and M2 incomplete, M3-M5 strategy-only, auth_redirect request_revision, final acceptance defer, and all representative acquisition and execution lanes defer.

Use governance and documentation consistency verification only; do not draft a specification, create or promote schemas, accept or implement contracts, change adapters/runtime/CLI/MCP/providers/dependencies, run detector or behavior tests, access targets, issue receipts, publish, deploy, launch, commit, push, or create a pull request.
